    Games Howell Tukey post hoc tests

    compute_posthoc.Rd

    Based on http://www.psych.yorku.ca/cribbie/6130/games_howell.R

    compute_posthoc(y, x)

    Arguments

    y

    Vector continous variable

    x

    Vector factor

    Examples
